semiconductor_relevance: High — Sensofar specializes in high-accuracy optical metrology solutions essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Sensofar is a leading technology company in the field of 3D optical metrology, providing high-accuracy optical profilers that utilize confocal, interferometry, and focus variation techniques. Their solutions cater to both research and development as well as in-line production processes, ensuring precision in surface metrology critical for semiconductor applications.

regional_presence.United States: Sensofar has its own offices in the USA to support its operations and customer base.
regional_presence.Germany: The company maintains a presence in Germany to cater to the European market.
regional_presence.Asia: Sensofar is represented in Asia, enhancing its reach in the growing semiconductor market.
